research_calibration.evidence: EPA reports roughly 2–2.5 t solid waste per tonne aluminum from bauxite/alumina production. Original candidate represents generic game ore and total nonmetal residual, NOT a real bauxite refinery equipment or waste inventory.
Limestone calcination releases CO2. WBCSD default approx 0.51–0.525 t CO2 per tonne clinker, not including fuel combustion.

Chip design, wafer fabrication and assembly/test/packaging are distinct stages. PCB is a post-packaging assembly; single precision_electronics capability is deliberately abstract pending built cleanroom/fab.
USDA traces farming/ranching, processing, distribution, retail and food service, so preparation must consume real source goods. Candidate 700g meal is game balance, not nutritional advice.
Metal sheets/panels are formed, joined and cut. Candidate future variant is NOT original native QuantifiedLine panel (20kg->19kg panel+1kg scrap); use separate native binding.
